info.title: FireFlo OMNI API
info.description: One API for every channel and service in FireFlo OMNI.

get.description: The account's AI agents.

post.description: Start an agent: a name, a role and what it should achieve. It starts as a draft; its AI provider key is chosen on the panel.

get.description: One agent.

patch.description: Change an agent's setup: instructions, channels, knowledge, approvals, working hours, limits. A change that needs checking again makes it a draft until verified.

delete.description: Delete an agent. One that has worked contacts is kept for the record and switched off.

post.description: Put a ready agent live.
Switch an agent off; its open plans stop.
Check the agent's AI provider key and model answer.

get.description: An agent's workflow: the draft graph, its problems, its revision and the live version.

put.description: Replace the draft graph. Send the revision you read; someone else's newer save is refused revision_conflict.

post.description: Make the draft live as a new version, with a note.

get.description: Published versions, newest first.

post.description: Publish an earlier version again, under a new number.

get.description: The agents working a contact.

post.description: Put a live agent on a contact (and one of their deals).
Pause an agent on a contact.
Take an agent off a contact; open plans stop.
Hand a contact back to its agent.
Ask an agent to plan for a contact now, with an optional note.

get.description: The agents' activity log, newest first; filter by agent or kind.
Knowledge collections, with how many sources each.

post.description: Add a knowledge collection.
Upload a file for agents to read (form field file): PDF, Word, CSV, text or Markdown.

get.description: What agents know: articles, FAQs, files and websites.

post.description: Add an article or FAQ, or a website for agents to read.
Read a source again now.

get.description: Agents' plans, newest first; status awaiting or open, agent, contact.
One plan and its steps.

post.description: Approve a plan waiting for approval, with optional edits to its steps.
Stop a plan that still has work ahead.
Reject a plan waiting for approval, with a note.

get.description: AI use per day — tokens, plans and replies — for 7, 14 or 30 days.

post.description: Up to 100 identify and track events at once.

get.description: The account's broadcasts, newest first — sent from the panel or the API. Filter by status or channel.

post.description: Send one message to many people on one channel: inline recipients with the values for their {{tags}}, saved contacts and segments, or a saved audience. It is prepared, screened for consent, quiet hours and stops, and sent at the channel's pace — now, or at scheduled_for.

get.description: One broadcast: its status, how many recipients it has, and how many were skipped, sent, delivered, failed or are still waiting.

post.description: Cancel a broadcast with messages still to send: what was sent stays sent, and the rest are closed as never sent.

get.description: Each message a broadcast sent: who it went to and how it ended, newest first. Filter by status: queued, sent, delivered, read, failed…

post.description: Pause a broadcast that hasn't finished; nothing goes until it resumes.
Resume a paused broadcast: it carries on from where it stopped.
Send a scheduled broadcast now instead of at its time.

get.description: Appointments, newest first; filter by from and to (dates), status, staff (an email) or contact.

post.description: Book a contact into a free time of a booking type. The contact is sent the account's confirmation and reminders. A time no longer free is refused slot_taken.

get.description: One appointment, with its history.

patch.description: Change an appointment's notes, place, meeting link or mode.

post.description: Cancel an upcoming appointment, with an optional note.
Mark an appointment done.
Confirm a requested appointment.
Mark that the contact didn't come.
Move an upcoming appointment to another free time, optionally to another teammate.

get.description: What people can book: how long it lasts, prep before it, who takes it.

post.description: Add a booking type. Teammates are named by email.

delete.description: Delete a booking type — or switch it off, when appointments were booked as it.

get.description: Free starts for a booking type from one day to another (a week unless to says), per teammate — minimum notice and how far ahead included.
The team, and whether each can be booked.
The account's calls, newest first, whichever way they went. Filter by direction (inbound or outbound), status (dialling, started, ended, failed or missed), kind, or contact (a contact's id).

post.description: Ring someone into one of your IVRs or have a voice agent call them (target from GET /v1/calls/targets). Screened like any message: refused with not_permitted when their consent doesn't allow it. Answers 202 with the call; its status moves on as it is answered and ends.

get.description: One call: who, which way, how it ended and how long it lasted, and for a voice agent's call what was said and its summary.
What a call can be placed into: your published IVRs, and on your own voice organisation your voice agents.
Orders, newest first; filter by status or contact.

post.description: Place an order for a contact: items naming a product (or a sku), with a quantity. Prices are the product's own unless given.

get.description: One order, with its history.

post.description: Cancel an order.
Confirm an order. The customer is sent the account's confirmation on the channel the order came in on.
Decline an order; a reason, when given, is sent to the customer.
Mark an order fulfilled.

get.description: Products, newest first; filter by active, category, set or sku, or search with q (best matches first).

post.description: Add a product: a sku and a name at least, money in minor units. It is queued for the WhatsApp catalogue.

get.description: One product.

patch.description: Change a product; only what is sent changes. The sku can't change once WhatsApp has the product.

delete.description: Take a product off sale. It stays for the orders that name it.

post.description: Give a product its picture (form field image): PNG, JPEG or WebP, 8 MB at most.
Add or update products from a CSV (form field file), keyed on the sku.

get.description: Product sets, with how many products each holds.

post.description: Add a product set.

patch.description: Rename a set or change its description.

delete.description: Delete a set; its products stay.

get.description: Audiences, with how many are in each.

post.description: Save an audience from rules; its members are worked out in the background.

get.description: One audience and its rules.

patch.description: Rename an audience or change its rules (its members are worked out again).

delete.description: Delete an audience no agent or workflow uses.

get.description: Who is in an audience, latest to join first.

post.description: Work an audience's members out again now.

get.description: Where a contact stands on each channel, for marketing and updates, and the history.

post.description: Record consent for a channel (or all) and purpose, with proof — what the contact said, and where.

get.description: Pairs of contacts that look like one person, newest first.

post.description: Say two contacts aren't the same person; they won't be suggested again.
Merge lose into keep: messages, deals, tickets and the rest move; choices picks whose name, phone or fields win.

get.description: Built-in traits, and the account's own: counts, sums and last times of an event.

post.description: Add a trait worked out from an event over a window of days.

delete.description: Remove one of the account's traits.

get.description: Your own SMS gateway's balance. On FireFlo's shared gateway there is none of yours to show: see /v1/usage for your account's.
Your SMS sender IDs as registered at the gateway, with their status: approved, pending, rejected or withdrawn.

post.description: Ask for a sender ID: sender_id (as the operator registered it), and optional label, note and tlvs (tag=value, comma separated). It is pending until the gateway decides.

delete.description: Withdraw a sender ID request nobody has decided yet.

get.description: Your DLT templates as registered at the gateway, with their status. An SMS's text must fill one in where the gateway enforces them.

post.description: Ask for a DLT template: name, and body with {#var#} blanks where the text changes; optional note and tlvs. Pending until decided.

delete.description: Withdraw a template request nobody has decided yet.

get.description: Your WhatsApp message templates with Meta's approval status. Filter by status: approved, pending, rejected, paused or disabled.

post.description: Submit a template for Meta's approval: name (lower case, digits and underscores), category (utility, marketing or authentication), language, body with {{1}}-style values, and optional header_text and footer. It is pending until Meta decides.

get.description: One WhatsApp template, its parts and its approval status.

patch.description: Change a template's body, footer or category. Meta reviews every edit: it is pending, and can't be sent, until approved again.

delete.description: Delete a template in this one language.

get.description: Contacts, newest first; find one by phone (any number they have had), or filter by name, number or tag.

post.description: Add a contact. A number another contact already has is refused with contact_exists, naming that contact.

get.description: One contact, with every number and identifier, their fields, tags and consent.

patch.description: Change a contact. Fields given are set (null clears one); tags given replace theirs; a new phone keeps the old one as theirs.

post.description: Mark a contact never to be contacted (until a time, or for good), or lift it. Nothing is sent to them on any channel while it stands.

get.description: Conversations, the most recently active first. Filter by state (open, snoozed or closed; open by default), channel, unassigned=true, unread=true, or q (a name, a number or words from a message).
One conversation, with which channels may take a typed reply now (a WhatsApp conversation is open for 24 hours after the person last wrote) and where a reply goes if no channel is named.

patch.description: Close or reopen a conversation, snooze it, assign it to a team member by email (or null for nobody), set its priority, or set its labels by name.

get.description: A conversation's messages on every channel, newest first.

post.description: Mark a conversation read, sending read receipts on the channels that have them (WhatsApp's blue ticks).

Reply in a conversation, on the channel named or where a reply goes by default. Screened like a reply typed in the Inbox: refused with not_permitted when the person's consent doesn't allow it, and with channel_closed when the channel can't take typed text now. An AI agent on the conversation steps back, as when a person replies.

get.description: Deals, newest first; filter by pipeline, stage, status or contact.

post.description: Create a deal in a pipeline — in its first stage unless stage says which.

get.description: One deal.

patch.description: Move a deal, win or lose it, or change its title, value, contact or notes. A closing stage closes it; marking it won moves it to the won stage.

get.description: A deal's notes, newest first.

post.description: Add a note to a deal, signed as from the API.

get.description: A deal's story, newest first: its own changes and notes, and what happened with its contact since it began. before pages back.
The account's pipelines, in board order, each with its stages.

post.description: Add a pipeline. It starts with New, Contacted, Proposal and Won.

get.description: One pipeline and its stages.

delete.description: Delete a pipeline with no open deals; its closed deals go with it.

post.description: Add a stage at the end. outcome won or lost makes it the closing stage.

patch.description: Rename a stage, or make it (or stop it being) a closing stage.

delete.description: Delete a stage. If it holds deals, move_to names the stage they go to.

post.description: Put the stages in a new order: every stage id, once.

get.description: Every event a webhook endpoint can ask for, with what each means.

post.description: Who someone is: their user id, phone or email, and traits. Applied in the background.

get.description: The key's account and plan, and what the key may do: what an integration checks first.
Messages sent through the API, newest first; filter by reference or status.

post.description: Send one message to one person, trying each channel of a route in turn until one gets there. Answers 202: what happens next arrives as message.* events.

get.description: One message, with every attempt on every channel.

post.description: Stop a message still being tried: no further channel is tried.

get.description: Every report this account can run: the built-in ones, and the ones the team saved and shared. Run one with GET /v1/reports/{id}.

One report's figures: its columns, rows and totals. For its own period, or another — preset (30d, last_month…), or from and to (YYYY-MM-DD, in the account's time zone). compare=true adds the period before and the change. format=csv answers a CSV file.
A file a scheduled report wrote, CSV or Excel — the one a report.delivered event names when its rows were too many to send inline. Files are kept while they're among the account's most recent.

post.description: Figures for a query of your own: a source, its measures, up to two groups, filters, a period and a sort — the fields GET /v1/reports/sources lists. Nothing is saved. format=csv answers a CSV file.

get.description: What reports can be made of: each source with the dimensions it can be grouped and filtered by, and the measures it counts — the fields POST /v1/reports/run takes. With the periods and charts allowed.
Your routes, and what a message that names none is tried on.

post.description: Add a route: the channels a message is tried on, in order, and what counts as done on each.

get.description: One route.

patch.description: Change a route's name, steps or whether it is the default.

get.description: Everything your messages and calls can come from, on every channel you have: SMS sender IDs (with their registration status), your WhatsApp number, RCS bots and voice numbers. Filter by channel or status. A channel whose provider can't be asked right now is named in unavailable, and the rest are still listed.
Your templates, with the values each needs.

post.description: Add a template: one message, written once per channel, with {{values}}.

get.description: One template.

patch.description: Change a template's name, note or channel versions.

get.description: Tickets, newest first; filter by status, priority, assignee (an email), category or contact.

post.description: Open a ticket on a conversation, with a subject and optionally a priority, category and assignee. A ticket already open there is solved first.

get.description: One ticket, with its history.

patch.description: Change a ticket's status, priority, assignee, category or subject. On an open ticket the conversation changes with it, as in the Inbox.

post.description: Close a ticket. A closed ticket can't reopen.

get.description: A ticket's internal notes, oldest first.

post.description: Add an internal note — never sent to the customer.
Open a solved ticket again, unless another is open in its conversation.
Solve a ticket.

get.description: The account's ticket categories.

post.description: Add a category: a name and a colour.

delete.description: Delete a category; its tickets keep no category.

post.description: Something someone did: an event name and its properties.

get.description: What the account sent and received on each channel (messages, and SMS parts), its calls and minutes, its API requests, its balance and what was charged — for this month, or from and to (YYYY-MM-DD, in the account's time zone, up to a year). by=day adds a row per day and channel.
Your webhook endpoints.

post.description: Add a webhook endpoint. The answer carries its signing secret, shown this once.

get.description: One webhook endpoint.

patch.description: Change an endpoint's address, events, note, or pause it.

delete.description: Remove an endpoint. Nothing more is sent to it.

get.description: The latest deliveries to an endpoint: each event, its answer and its tries.

post.description: Make a new signing secret for an endpoint; deliveries are signed with it from now on.
Send a webhook.test event to an endpoint now, and answer how it went.

bearer.description: An OMNI API key: ff_live_… or ff_test_…
